justification: Temporary exact-path suppression for issue #20: Rust crate-level inner attributes begin with #![...] but are not interpreter shebangs. The underlying detector must be fixed without weakening real shebang executable-mode enforcement.

evidence.description: Rust fixture begins with #![forbid(unsafe_code)] and is correctly tracked as a non-executable source file. See egohygiene/egolint#20.
